rules.NET-1: When a provider is out of network, offer in-network alternatives.

rules.PA-0: The agent cannot approve care. Explain that the treating provider must request prior authorization; offer to send a letter explaining how.
rules.SMS-1: Text PHI only with explicit consent, to a number on file.
rules.END-1: Before ending, recap next steps and log the outcome.
